reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college.

review_content.Placements: The placements are okay. But it all depends on us to crack the interview. And not complete placement is provided. The labs are not that good. I think some more high instruments, equipment, and chemicals should be added. Overall, Andhra University provides a comprehensive and supportive environment for students to pursue their academic and extracurricular interests.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi. We have a big library, and the food in the canteen is excellent. There is a hospital where we can go. The hostels are good, and okay mess food As I was a day scholar, I got to know it by my friends. Andhra University encourages students to participate in sports and games, promoting physical fitness and teamwork.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with the faculty and facilities.

review_content.Placements: In my college, there is not much availability for placements for students. The students belonging to both MPC and Bi. PC groups are eligible to join the B. Pharmacy course, which is a 4-year course. Students with above-average marks are eligible for this course. There are few companies that offer jobs. If any company recruits, the package may be INR 2.8 LPA for freshers. The top recruiting companies are Hetero, Pfizer, Biophore, Lee Pharma, Aurobindo, Biopharma, etc. The college did not provide any internships, but if we have any interest in doing one, the college gives permission to do one.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: I'm satisfied with this college but not with internships and placements.

review_content.Placements: Maximum of 75% of students get placed in our course. The salary package offered is average. Top recruiting companies are Lee Pharma, Pulses, etc. Internships are not provided but our college gives permission for students to do internships in any company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are average. Wi-Fi is available but it doesn't work well. Labs are provided but there is no proper equipment. Classrooms are neat and clean. Library is provided to study books. The quality of infrastructure is average.

reviews_list.batch_info: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Our university is excellent.

review_content.Placements: Almost 70% of students are placed based on their skills and performance. The salary package purely depends on the companies where students are placed. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Clinical pharmacist is the top role offered in our course.
review_content.Infrastructure: In this college, the infrastructure of the lab is very good. The hostel is nearby for girls and it is very good for girls. The medical dispensary is provided.
review_content.Faculty: This course is a 6-year graduation course that consists of a 1-year internship. Semester exams are conducted yearly. Teachers explain very well and the remaining 70% of hard work depends on students' effort. Semester exams are easy if students read well from the very beginning and it is easy to get a good percentage.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Overall review for AU college of pharmaceutical sciences.

review_content.Placements: After the final year of the 1st semester, there are opportunities for placements. There are also many placement opportunities here. Many popular and best industrial companies visit our college for placements, and also salary packages offered are also best. High salary packages are offered here compared to other private colleges as the highest salary package offered is 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2.6 LPA. Just B. Pharmacy students here can get a salary of around Rs. 25,000-30,000 per month. It is a far good salary package compared to other colleges. The maximum of 90% of students get placements, while about 80% of students get good internships. All salary packages offered are good. I am planning to pursue an MBA or M. Pharmacy after this degree. Accenture, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, HCL, IBM, Infosys, ITC, Pfizer. , Reliance Industries Limited, TCS and also other good companies offer placements and internships here.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: It is one of the best colleges in Andhra Pradesh, with good research and the best faculty.

review_content.Placements: Many students are interested in higher studies after B. Pharmacy, so only a few students got placed. The packages range between 1.5 to 2 LPA, depending on our skills and communication skills in the interview. We have good connections with the industry and alumni organisations. Roles offered are quality assurance, quality control etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are good. The classrooms are new. We have a library in our department with all the required books. Wi-Fi is available. We have a dispensary for medical purposes. We have a huge playground, and an indoor stadium for shuttle and boxing. Every thing is good. One can enjoy a lot here.

overview_faqs.question: Is hostel fee refunded in case of admission cancellation at Jamia Hamdard?
overview_faqs.answer: In case a student does not join the hostel but informs the Provost Office within a week after payment of the hostel fee about the withdrawal, the hostel charges are then refunded after deduction of INR 1000. In case the student withdraws admission within one month of joining of hostel, the fee is refunded after a deduction of 25% of the hostel fee. In any other case, no fee except security deposit is refundable. It is refunded to the hosteller after he/she has paid all dues and vacated the hostel.

review_summary.college_name: Jamia Hamdard Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want to relax and only degree, then go.

content.Placements: About 70% student got placement. The highest package is 30 LPA, and the average is 6 LPA. Companies like Wipro, HCL, and some foreign companies recruit. Students got 100% internship roles like developed trainee and so on. My college fees are so high, about 9 lakhs too.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are enough, okay, but infrastructure needs construction, and some classes are not well organized. So Wi-Fi also does work proper. The hostel is good, but there is also a bad thing about wash room. Overall, there is no much facilities provide as other.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in International Studies and Global Politics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Truly satisfied with the campus life and facilities.

content.Placements: This is a new course in Jamia Hamdard. My batch is the second batch, so I don’t have any idea about placements, but the university also offers M.A. in this course as well as Ph.D. in this course. This course has good scope in India and especially outside.
content.Infrastructure: Amazing infrastructure; they provide Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, a decent library, and they have around 4–5 canteens with good quality food. They conduct sports events and tournaments every few months, so overall a good experience. I don’t have any idea about hostel, but the rest everything is nice, and they also have a hospital on campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am not saying that the college is bad, but the students are.

content.Placements: 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package is around 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. TCS and Wipro are regular recruiting companies. 30 percent of students get internships in various companies like Infosys and TCS. Roles offered are software developer and web developer.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. Only the canteen, campus, and medical facilities are good, the rest are average. The library is noisy every time I see it. Labs are not good, systems don't work often. Only cricket is good, no other sport. Everything is taken lightly, and there are fights very often.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members and placements are good every year, and the infrastructure is average.

content.Placements: Almost 70–80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. Recruiting organizations include some universities and hospitals. Roles offered are professor and physiotherapist roles in sports, neuro, musculoskeletal, and cardiovascular specializations. Many alumni start working abroad, and we have a wide range of options for how we want to work.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is above average, and we can rate it 4/10. Some cons include lift issues and Wi-Fi speed. Labs have almost all the required equipment. Hostel facilities are average. They charge a high amount, but facilities are not worth it. Mess and canteen are available, and their prices are reasonable. Medical facilities are good, as we have a hospital and a rehabilitation centre. In sports, we have football, volleyball, badminton, basketball, cricket, table tennis, carrom, and chess. We need improvement in all these areas.

individual_reviews.course: BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Not the best but not the worst either.

content.Placements: As much as I have heard, the placement records are not very high. Teachers help in getting you placed, but it is your job to find a good job, and very few students get placed from the college itself. 30 percent of the students get placed maybe much less as specific records aren't mentioned. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 2.8 LPA, and the average is 3 LPA-4.5 LPA. Several companies such as HCL, Tata, Coca-Cola, and others. From my course 70 percent of students got internships Roles that are offered are data analyst, customer executive, salesforce, managerial roles, etc.

faqs.question: Is Jamia Hamdard University under CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Hamdard offers admission to students on the basis of CUET entrance exam. The college will release the final merit list of the basis of scores obtained by the students in this exam. Candidates can check the official website for more information.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: Jamia Hamdard releases its recent admission guidelines or prospectus on the official website a the start of the admission for each academic year. Students must check the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria and follow the process. Admission to all the courses is either merit or entrance based. For instance, admission to the BTech and MBBS courses are subject to JEE Main and NEET UG exams, However, for courses, such as BCA, admission is subject to merit in Class 12 in the best of five subjects. Additionally,  the deemed-to-be University accepts CUET UG conducted by NTA for a few of its UG courses, namely BA, BA (Hons), BSc (Hons), BBA, BJMC and BCom.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff of Jamia Hamdard?
faqs.answer: The cutoff for Jamia Hamdard University is the minimum marks that a candidate must achieve to get considered for admission to Jamia Hamdard University. The cutoff is diverse for each category and course. For example, the cutoff for the MBBS programme is quite different for General category students as compared with the OBC students. The cutoff marks and scores for Jamia Hamdard University are decided by quite a number of factors, including the total seats available for the students, the number of applicants, and the average scores of the various applicants. The cutoff is generally released after the results are released for the NEET. For cutoff-related details, please visit the official website of Jamia Hamdard University.

placement_data.title: Jamia Hamdard Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: According to the Annual Report 2024-25 released, a total of 28 students were placed from the School of Pharmaceutical Education & Research (SPER). The salary package recorded during Jamia Hamdard placements for SPER was between INR 3 LPA and 26 LPA . From School of Nursing Sciences and Allied Health (SNSAH), 99 students were placed with salary package ranging from 3 LPA to 6 LPA .

During Jamia Hamdard placements 2025, 45 students were placed and 45 students opted for higher studies from School of Engineering Sciences and Technology (SEST). The top recruiters included Accenture and Deloitte .

In School of Chemical and Life Sciences (SCLS), 29 students were placed with salary package between 2.5 LPA and 4.5 LPA . Further, 12 students of School of Interdisciplinary Sciences and Technology were placed with package between 1.2 LPA and 10 LPA .
In Centre for Media and Mass Communication, 5 students were placed with salary package between 3 LPA and 5 LPA during Jamia Hamdard placement 2025.

college_info.intro:
GMCH Chandigarh offers UG, PG and Advanced Master's level programmes in the fields like Nursing, Medicine and Health Sciences. Government Medical College and Hospital Chandigarh offers MBBS and MD as its flagship courses. These courses are offered in affiliation with Panjab University. MBBS is provided at the UG level for the duration of 5.5 years, which includes a 1-year compulsory internship program. The annual student intake for the course is 150. GMCH MBBS admission is based on the NEET-UG scores.
MD is offered for the duration of 3 years in General Medicine, Anaesthesia, Psychiatry, Biochemistry, Forensic Medicine and Paediatrics, among others. Students need to qualify NEET-PG to get seats in MD. After completing MD, students can work as a Specialist Consultant in Hospitals or Clinics, or can get into Super-specialisation like DM in Cardiology, Neurology, etc. Students also have the opportunities to get into Academic Research. individual_reviews.course: MD in General Medicine - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of GMCH Chandigarh - Government Medical College and Hospital.

content.Placements: Government Medical College and Hospital, Chandigarh (GMCH), offers strong placement opportunities, particularly in the medical field. There are no traditional placements with companies recruiting, and graduates are well-prepared for various career paths, including government jobs, postgraduate studies, and private practice. All GMCHs provide compulsory internships, often with a stipend. Many graduates secure positions in medical offices or pursue further specialisation.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is not that big. It is very beautiful at the same time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Short review of GMCH college for nursing.

content.Placements: I am from batch 2023 B.Sc. Nursing (currently in second year, 3rd sem nursing). Almost everyone, but placement doesn’t depend upon the college as there is no direct placement. Placement depends upon how good you studied in your course. The highest – many of the students cleared NCLEX from our college. The lowest – can’t say anything. Generally, students prefer to work in AIIMS. Yes, everyone gets a chance for an internship.
content.Infrastructure: For nursing, it is very poor. Like, only 2 lecture theatres in college and clinical hours are too much. The hostel is combined with the two lecture theatres, which is awful. For attending external subjects, we have to go to E block many times, which is really frustrating. College timing is 9 to 5. No Wi-Fi for students. The library is too good (2 libraries in college). No canteen in college, but in E block of the hospital, there are lots of canteens.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I can't say this college is good or bad, but placement is good, and the future is secure.

content.Placements: All students were placed as it is a medical college and MBBS as a degree allows everyone to earn money. Everyone was allowed for internships. Some crack their NEET PG, and some of them go towards USMLE and PLAB for pursuing their medicine from abroad.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good for students. Hostels are very good with all facilities. Only hostel food is not good; rest everything is very good. Seniors are friendly too. Wi-Fi is not available in hostels, but the library is present in three blocks of the college with Wi-Fi and good infrastructure. Classrooms are also fully equipped with Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My MBBS journey at GMC, Chandigarh.

content.Placements: GMCH is the best medical college in India. At GMCH, all the students get internships for our course. For placements, students have to pass the PG Exam, and on this basis, they get placed in various hospitals. The average package offered for our course was 5–8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: GMCH has really good infrastructure for our course. In our course, all the necessary facilities, like labs and hospitals, were available for the students to practice. Students also got other facilities like sports, canteen, hostel, library, Wi-Fi, etc., at this college.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides great internships.

content.Placements: No placements are provided here because it's a medical college, but you can join a hospital of your choice. You can also prepare for NEET PG for 1 year and then do a speciality course like MD or MS. An internship of one year is compulsory, for which you get a stipend of Rs. 31,000 per month, which is above average.
content.Infrastructure: All the required books are not easily available. Sometimes, we have to order them from Amazon. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The hostels have two-seater and single-seater rooms. Each room has enough space. Rooms are very clean and have adequate lights and fans. The food served in the mess is of high quality. They serve chicken, fish, and paneer every week. PGs and rental rooms are also available.

review_content.Placements: It's an undergraduate degree; as soon as you pass your final exam, you have to do a one-year internship from your college, and they pay you 30,000 per month. After that, you can join a private hospital, where the minimum salary is about 40,000 as an undergraduate, or you can go for PG.
review_content.Infrastructure: In my college, you will get a proper campus for only the first year; after that, you will be shifted to another hostel, and from there, all the venues for classes and postings are at different places, so you will mostly need a vehicle. The hostel mess is good, and all other facilities are great. There is a sports complex in the college where you can play squash, football, basketball, table tennis, etc., and there is a gym, but you have to pay for it.

reviews_list.review_title: BPT programme in KMC Bangalore provides good facilities and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: In our college, there is no placement program, but there is an internship program. We work in Manipal hospitals such as KMC Attavara, KMC Jyothi, and KMC Bejai for pediatrics.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has good facilities, including air-conditioned classrooms and labs. The central library at Falnir has a wide selection of books and research publications. The hostel fee is around INR 1,20,000, which includes a mess card that can be used like an ATM card in the mess. admission_process.title: KMC Mangalore Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: KMC Mangalore admissions are currently open for various courses. The college offers various programmes at theUG, PG and certificate levelsin the field ofMedical Science.Kasturba Medical College Mangaloreoffers entrance and merit-based admission. The application form is available on the official website of theManipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). Candidates are required to register for their desired programme by paying an application fee ofINR 600on an online portal MAHE. Read below to learn more about KMC Mangalore admission 2025,along with course-wise eligibility and selection criteria and admission process:
Manipal 2025 Applications Open|Apply Now

KMC Mangalore admissions 2025 areopenfor some courses like MS, MD, etc. The college accepts scores of college-level and national-level entrance exams, such as NEET. For a few courses, however, admission is subject to scores obtained by the candidates in the MET entrance. Interested candidates for admission can check out Kasturba Medical College Mangalore top highlights in the given table:
Particulars
KMC Admission Highlights 2025
Mode of study
Admission status
How to apply?
MAHE official website (apply.manipal.edu)
Level of programmes offered
UG, PG, Certificate

KMC Mangalore admission process is conducted in online mode. The college offers BSc, MSc, MS and other programmes at the UG and PG levels. It also offers a certificate programme. An overview of KMC Mangalore courses eligibility & selection criteria for admission 2025 is as follows:
Eligibility
Selection Criteria
Pass Class 10 and Class 12 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry and English with Biology / Mathematicsfrom a recognised Board, with a minimum of 45 %aggregate marks in PCB / PCM
Pass BSc in relevant field with 50% aggregate
Pass BPT from a recognised University, withminimum 50 % aggregate marks or equivalent
A pass in BArch with 50% aggregate
Pass an MBBS degree from an Institution /University recognised by National Medical Council(NMC) / the erstwhile Medical Council of India
Check here for detailed eligibility criteria for moreKMC Mangalore courses

Kasturba Medical College Mangalore admission process 2025 is bothentrance and merit-based. Candidates seeking admission to KMC Mangalore must qualify for the respective entrance exams and other selection rounds including applying online on the official website of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). Checkout the following steps for a detailedKMC Mangalore admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

Candidates looking for admission to various courses at KMC Mangalore are required to submit an online application form along with a registration fee ofINR 600. The application form will not be accepted by the college without submitting the required documents.
Step 2: Selection Round

As part of the selection process, candidates are required to qualify for the college/ national-level entrance exam basis the course-level eligibility set by the college. The selection criteria vary from one course to another, for instance, for MBBS and MD courses applicants are required to appear for NEET-PG to get admission, however, for BSc, MSc, MPT and others, the college conducts its own entrance exam conducted by MAHE. After the selection rounds are over, the college releases a list of shortlisted candidates based on their eligibility fulfilment and scores in the selection rounds.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment
KMC Mangalore releases a merit list after the selection rounds are over based on their eligibility fulfilment and scores in the selection rounds.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation
The selected candidates in theKMC Mangalore cutofflist must required to payKMC Mangalore course feepayment within the given dates to lock their seats.

faqs.question: When did NTA release the NEET 2024 result?
faqs.answer: The NEET 2025 result is expected to be released in the first week of June 2025, within a month of conducting the exam. NTA does not announce the NEET result date in advance. Although last year the result date was stated to be declared on June 14, NTA released it 10 days in advance. Hence, there is no fixed date or schedule for NTA to declare the NEET result. Prior to the declaration of the result, NTA releases the final NEET answer key. Last year, NEET was conducted on May 5 and the result was declared June 4.

reviews.review_heading: Top-notch medical education with excellent clinical exposure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is provided. There is a large capacity library with rich digital and print collections. We also have modern medical labs, and a simulation center for hands-on experience and training. There are four hospitals with specialty services and teaching exposure. The campus is comfortable and well furnished with amenities, hygiene, and maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: M.Sc. in Medical Microbiology.
reviews.review_text: There were enough spacious areas for relaxing, studying, and working. Specialized libraries were arranged for searching and observations according to the subject's needs. It was mandatory to wear identity cards within the campus. Otherwise, penalties would be collected.

reviews.review_heading: Life at KMC Mangalore as an undergraduate doctor.
reviews.review_text: In my college, you will get a proper campus for only the first year; after that, you will be shifted to another hostel, and from there, all the venues for classes and postings are at different places, so you will mostly need a vehicle. The hostel mess is good, and all other facilities are great. There is a sports complex in the college where you can play squash, football, basketball, table tennis, etc., and there is a gym, but you have to pay for it.

reviews.review_heading: BPT programme in KMC Bangalore provides good facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities, including air-conditioned classrooms and labs. The central library at Falnir has a wide selection of books and research publications. The hostel fee is around INR 1,20,000, which includes a mess card that can be used like an ATM card in the mess. The college has a sports complex called the Manipal Arena, which is free to use except for the gym.

reviews.review_heading: Detailed review of KMC, Mangalore.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available except air conditioners. The food quality is okay, neither too good nor too bad. Sports and extra curricular activities are conducted in the Arena. There are many sports played in the Arena like basketball, badminton, etc. The campus is equipped with Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is a good college that provides an excellent balance of academics and social activities.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of the college is really good. It offers a calm environment for students to carry on with their work. The hostel facility provided by the college is quite promising. The rooms are well furnished with all the basic amenities needed by students. The mess is kept clean and the food is decent in there. Medical facilities are available for students 24/7; ambulance services are provided when needed; and there are basketball and badminton courts on the campus itself.

reviews.review_heading: There are ample opportunities here.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are newly made with all the kinds of amenities related to audio-visual aids are available. There is a Wi-Fi facility available which is a bit slow. The hostels are in good conditions along with the wardens being  good. Regular cleaning is done in the hostels to ensure hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS/BDS at KMC helping learn and grow.
reviews.review_text: Best of the facilities are provided here, experienced clinicians and faculty who are always available to guide and support in academics and beyond. Hostel offers conducive environment for students to grow. Mess food is hygienic and nutritious. Moreover, suitable for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, Happy and Recommendable for those who can afford.
reviews.review_text: The college has a really good campus and hostel Life is the best for freshers and after that the freshers have to shift to nandagiri hostel (girls) and kaprigudda (boys). So the environment is really student friendly and also very clean. Library is very nice. Mess food is very nice. People come for inspection every month. Wi-Fi is available in the library as well as the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college in all aspects.
reviews.review_text: For hostels, students have two options i.e air-conditioner double seater and non-air-conditioner double seater. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and on campus. Laboratories, classrooms, and library are well furnished. In the KMC Bangalore to overcome the ragging, there is a separate campus for 1st-year students. Mess food is better than in other hostels. Ambulance service is available 24X7 for any medical emergency. For sports, there is a Marena Sports Complex at some distance from campus, and from...

reviews.review_heading:
Life of Medical students
See my quora.
reviews.review_text: We have a main Lighthouse building where all 2nd and 3rd year subjects are present. The central library is there with uptill 11 30 PM. The campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi facilities. Classroom are centralised AC with all facilities. Hostel are in Bejai (1st year only) and Kaprigudda and Sturrock (NRI). There is sport complex Marena with all sport facilities gym etc.

reviews.review_heading: This college is a good option for quality medical education, and it provides good campus life.
reviews.review_text: Classroom, laboratories, and libraries are fully air-conditioned. While in hostel rooms students have an option for an air-conditioner or non-air-conditioner on the whole campus. The hostels are fully Wi-Fi access, and classrooms have projectors, speakers for better audio-visual lectures. Mess food is rich in variety, students get all the north Indian food, and even snacks like tikki, samosa, maggi, vada pav, etc., which are good.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best medical colleges in India and is part of Manipal Academy of higher education.
reviews.review_text: All the required facilities are provided to us, including Wi-Fi, medical, labs, classrooms, and hospital visits. There is a huge central library on campus. Hostel facilities and mess facilities are all good. We are provided with a good library in the hostel as well, which is open 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: A good college, worth the money spent, best decision of my life.
reviews.review_text: It's not a huge college campus as most colleges but the facilities available are good. We have a well-equipped library which has ample space. A sports campus called marina is also there wh oh has a gym available with trainers as well. Canteen is also good. And the hostels are comfortable with mess food better than most hostel messes as heard. Being a medical college medical facilities are A1.

reviews.review_heading: Worth securing your future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is one of the best in Asia. AC classrooms with sloping seating arrangements. Projectors installed. Library is amazing with availability of books for all the courses. There are libraries in hostel campus as well. Which saves time for traveling to Central library. Mess is very tidy and hygienic. Veg and non veg food is available in canteen and mess both. Mess is controlled by "chef on wheels". There are both AC and non AC rooms non AC rooms available in the hostel. Girls and boy...

faqs.answer: MRIIRS admissions are based on both merit and entrance based criteria. Students can visit the official website of the university and find out more about the eligibility details for their chosen course. Students can choose to apply directly on the basis of their merit scoring in the previous qualifying exam. For the majority of the programs, students can apply on the basis of prescribed entrance tests such as JEE Mains, SAT, Pearson, MRNAT, CUET, XAT, CAT, among others.
faqs.question: Q: Can I get direct admission in MRIIRS Faridabad?

faqs.answer: MRIIRS Faridabad admissions begin with registration. Below are the step-wise admission process:Step One: Submission of Online ApplicationVisit the official website which is manavrachna.edu.in/mriirsStep Two: Uploading DocumentsAspirants need to upload a Class 12 mark sheet, a Valid Score of JEE Mains/ GATE, SAT/UNIGAUGE (if appeared), a Valid score of CLAT, Pre-final Year Mark sheets of higher education qualification (For PG Program).Step Three: Selection of Candidate and Offer of Admission LetterMerit Defining Document: Admission to various programs is based on merit as specified in Admission Brochure. Admissions to all programs are also made based on Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for which the scores shall automatically be picked up for merit.Step Four: Accepted of Admission and Payment of FeeAll the selected candidates for admission at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies, who receive Admission Offer Letter from the University shall be required to send the Acceptance of Admission for the offered programme in the format which shall be sent by the University Authority along with the Admission Offer Letter.Thereafter, the candidate shall be required to deposit the first installment of fee for various programmes within one week of offer of admission by using any mode as mentioned below (after Step-five).Step Five: Physical Verification of Documents and Enrollment ProcessAll the candidates, who have accepted the admission after receipt of Admission Offer Letter, shall be required to report at designated venue’s for “Physical Document Verification / Enrollment Process” as per the slots are given to them. Aspirants are required to bring Letter of ‘Offer of Admission’ and all the original fee receipts.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee of Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee will cost approximate 1.5 Lacs at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies for a year including hostel and mess charges. There is an option for you to choose AC or non-AC rooms.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies under CUET?
overview_faqs.answer: No, Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies is not under CUET. CUET, which stands for Central Universities Common Entrance Test, is a national entrance test administered by the NTA for MCA/Msc programs, but it does not include Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies in its scope.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies approved?
overview_faqs.answer: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC). The university is also accredited by NAAC with A+ grade. Further, it has been conferred with 5-star rating for Teaching, Employability, Academic Development, Facilities, Social Responsibility, and Inclusiveness by the QS Rating System.

overview_faqs.question: What is the duration for MCA course at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies?
overview_faqs.answer: The duration for MCA course is two years. The seat intake for the course is 120. The selection criteria for MCA at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies is merit preparation/shortlisting of candidates shall be on the basis of score in MRNAT/ Marks in Qualifying Examination.

review_summary.college_name: MRIIRS Faridabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A solid college choice with updated labs, internship opportunities, and improved placement.

content.Placements: The highest package is of 55 LPA, and the lowest is 3-4 LPA and 70-75%of students got placed. Well-known companies participated in the placement drive like TCS, HCL, Capgemini, Cognizant, which offer top roles like software engineer, Web developer, Data analyst and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Our department provides well-maintained infrastructure and facilities to support academic and practical learning. There is also a sports arena where there is a coach of boxing, shooting and many sports instruments. Wi-fi is also available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Manav Rachna campus placement review

content.Placements: The Civil Engineering Department at SET, MRIIRS, along with the CRC, provides strong placement support, offering nearly 95 percent placement for eligible students, and through technical guidance and interview preparation, they help students become industry-ready.
content.Infrastructure: The department offers good infrastructure, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped civil engineering labs, and an updated library with relevant books and journals. The hostels provide clean rooms and essential amenities, and the mess offers decent-quality food with a variety of options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Balanced learning environment with strong labs and good placement.

content.Placements: The placement rate at my campus is about 100 percent. The average package in the civil department is 4 LPA to 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Mega, Ultratech, etc. Around 100 percent of students got internships from any course. The top roles offered in my course are Structural Design Engineer, Site Engineer, and Highway Designer.
content.Infrastructure: MRIIRS has smart classrooms. The labs are quite well-equipped for civil engineering. Especially, we have labs like the survey lab, structure lab, concrete technology lab, soil mechanics lab, and fluid mechanics lab. There is a central library for both digital and physical resources.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of all facilities.

content.Placements: The placement cell is active and supportive. We get regular training sessions, aptitude practice, interview preparation, and soft-skill development. Many companies visit the campus, and students get good opportunities in both core and non-core sectors. Internships are also provided in the third, fifth, and final years, which really help in gaining experience.
content.Infrastructure: MRIIRS has very good infrastructure. The classrooms are clean and air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped, and the library has a great study environment. Civil Engineering labs like Surveying, Concrete Technology, Environmental, Geotechnical, and Structures are modern and provide hands-on learning. The campus is green, well-maintained, and has strong Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and good canteens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfying because of the many facilities and the faculty.

content.Placements: Almost 60 to 70% of students got placed in my course, and the highest package till now is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. There are many top recruiting companies for my course, and almost 90% of students got internships from our course in many companies. The top role offered in our course is in big research and future bio projects.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure and facilities, as they provide us with free Wi-Fi, have AC in every classroom, and have 3 big libraries where any student can go and study. The labs are also very good, as they have the latest machines and a good environment.

admission_process.title: MRIIRS Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studiesadmits students based on various national-level entrance exams such as JEE Mains 2025/ SAT / Pearson / MRNAT 2025, CUET, XAT, CAT etc. The mode of application at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is online.

The institute offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Business and Management Studies, Accounting, and Commerce among others. Popular courses offered by the university are MCA, BCA, MBA, BTech and BBA. MRIIRS Faridabad also offers multiple scholarships to support meritorious students and provide financial aid. Read on to know more aboutManav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies course admissions2025.

The university offers courses in full-time mode over 20 courses. MRIIRS Faridabad offers more than 20 courses across various specialisations and aspirants need to apply for courses through the official website. MRIIRS Faridabad offers courses in the fields ofEngineering, Business and Management Studies,Accounting, and Commerce among others. Students seeking admission must meet the course-specific eligibility and selection conditions. The below-mentioned table carries course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies course admissions 2025:
Eligibility
MAT,XAT,CAT,CUET-PG,ATMA/ JMET / SNAP / MR-NAT/MR-MAT, GD-PI, Behavioral skill test, Work Experience/ Extracurricular achievements
The admission process in 2025 is divided into five steps. Students can check the detailed points mentioned below:
Step One: Submission of Online Application
Visit the official website which is https://manavrachna.edu.in/mriirs
Step Two: Uploading Documents

Aspirants need to upload a Class 12 mark sheet, a Valid Score of JEE Mains/ GATE, SAT/UNIGAUGE (if appeared), a Valid score of CLAT, Pre-final Year Mark sheets of higher education qualification (For PG Program).
Step Three: Selection of Candidate and Offer of Admission Letter

Merit Defining Document: Admission to various programs is based on merit as specified in Admission Brochure. Admissions to all programs are also made based on Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for which the scores shall automatically be picked up for merit.
Step Four: Accepted of Admission and Payment of Fee

All the selected candidates for admission at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies, who receive Admission Offer Letter from the University shall be required to send the Acceptance of Admission for the offered programme in the format which shall be sent by the University Authority along with the Admission Offer Letter.

Thereafter, the candidate shall be required to deposit the first installment of fee for various programmes within one week of offer of admission by using any mode as mentioned below (after Step-five).
Step Five: Physical Verification of Documents and Enrollment Process

All the candidates, who have accepted the admission after receipt of Admission Offer Letter, shall be required to report at designated venue’s for “Physical Document Verification / Enrollment Process” as per the slots are given to them. Aspirants are required to bring Letter of ‘Offer of Admission’ and all the original fee receipts.

Admissions to various courses at JSS Medical college are about to begin soon.

college_info.intro:
JSS Medical College offers a range of courses in fields like Medicine, Denistry, Pharmacy, Health Sciences, etc. The college offers courses at the UG, PG, and Doctorate levels. A number of Diploma & Certificate courses are also offered by the College. MBBS & BSc are the flagship courses offered by the institution. The duration of the MBBS course is 4 ½ years followed by compulsory rotating internship training of one year. Students who want to take admission for MBBS course need to give NEET UG Exam conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA) followed by MCC counselling or KEA counselling for Karnataka state quota. There are 250 seats offered by the college for MMBS programme.
BSc Nursing is another popular course at JSS Medical college at UG level. It is offered in multiple streams like Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT), Forensic Science, Cardiac Care Technology, etc. After completing the course students can work in Hospitals, Clinics or go for higher studies like MSc which is also offered by the college. overview_faqs.question: Is JSS Medical College a good college?
overview_faqs.answer: JSS Medical college was established between 1984-85. It is a private medical college located in Mysore, Karnataka. It is recognised by the Medical Council of India. It has now become a constituent college of JSS Academy of Higher Education & Research which is accredited with NAAC with Grade "A+". JSS Medical college is ranked 37th by NIRF in "Medical" category in 2025. JSS medical college has a big campus spread over 43 acres & offers facilities like Hostel, Library, Sports, Medical, Research, Banking, etc. to the students. The JSS hospital is one of the India's the biggest hospital equipped with 1800 beds under one roof with the latest technology and best medical practices. The hospital provides services in 37 specialties/super specialties and has 67 special clinics offering both inpatient and outpatient services. Overall it is a very good college for doing medical related courses.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical Laboratory Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I will always recommend this college to upcoming students.

content.Placements: Our college provides good knowledge and placements. Placement opportunities are high after graduating from this college.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and all provide good quality food in our canteen. It has pure vegetarian food only. We have a Wi-Fi facility, a well-equipped laboratory, and classrooms. The library has every minor detail book related to studies. Overall, it's the best.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are so good, well-trained, and well-educated. They always have the capability to teach us and clear our doubts. Semester examinations are a little bit tough, but we can go through studies, and the faculty members will help us. The pass percentage is 40%.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: JSS Medical College. An excellent choice.

content.Placements: The internship and placement in our course are amazing, and our college provides many opportunities through connections with various hospitals. The internship experience is excellent and offers exposure to the real world. The top roles offered after our course include medicine, surgery, cardiology, radiology, dermatology, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is decent and labs are well-equipped with the latest technology for better student understanding. The hostel infrastructure is outstanding with multiple types of rooms available for students including both common and attached washroom options. There are Wi-Fi-enabled labs and a library on the college campus. The food facility in the hostel is decent. The medical facilities are available, and there is also a canteen on campus. Many sports facilities are provided for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical Imaging Technology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College is good. Friends are great. Campus and everything is good.

content.Placements: 50% of students got high marks and got placed. The highest salary is Rs. 70,000 per month and the lowest package is Rs. 30000 per month. Everyone got placed in JSS Hospital. For everyone, internships are compulsory for the last 1 year in JSS Hospital.
content.Infrastructure: Our course is good. Teaching is good and there is a library to read. Wi-Fi is also available but there is no hostel facility. Hostel is there but only for MBBS students for them hostel is too good. Food is best compared to other hostel food. It is hygienic and hostel rooms are very clean for B.Sc. Outside PGs are available they are also too good like college hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Medical Biochemistry - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This college is top 24 in India this would be the best college you choose.

content.Placements: 75% of students are placed in a very good company the outside state and even countries, and the package was 10 LPA for freshers and the average package was 6LPA Recruit companies are Thermo Fisher Scientific, Sun Pharma, Biocon, Johnson and Johnson, and many other. Many students have gotten internships in Thermo Fisher Scientific, sinex many companies Medical coding, technician, research fellow, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus, highly facilitated laboratory, many ongoing research, availability of very good books. Wi-Fi and smart class facilitated classrooms, digital library, and library till midnight even have a department library also free research journals.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Medical Biochemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Best college for research, good infrastructure, and well-equipped labs.

content.Placements: As being a medical college, there are no placement facilities like other colleges. But there is more chance of getting placed in a company or industry after passing out from here. Teachers will refer students to companies or industries for a job after their studies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is superb. The building is nice and well-planned with good architecture. The campus is also nice and eco-friendly. Classrooms are very spacious, and there is a very big auditorium. The college has two libraries: one is the main library, and the other is the digital library. The Wi-Fi connection is good, and anyone can use it.

reviews.review_heading: JSS Medical College. An excellent choice.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is decent and labs are well-equipped with the latest technology for better student understanding. The hostel infrastructure is outstanding with multiple types of rooms available for students including both common and attached washroom options. reviews.review_heading: College is good. Friends are great. Campus and everything is good.
reviews.review_text: Our course is good. Teaching is good and there is a library to read. Wi-Fi is also available but there is no hostel facility. Hostel is there but only for MBBS students for them hostel is too good. Food is best compared to other hostel food. It is hygienic and hostel rooms are very clean for B.Sc. Outside PGs are available they are also too good like college hostel.

reviews.review_heading: This college is top 24 in India this would be the best college you choose.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi all over the campus, highly facilitated laboratory, many ongoing research, availability of very good books. Wi-Fi and smart class facilitated classrooms, digital library, and library till midnight even have a department library also free research journals.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for research, good infrastructure, and well-equipped labs.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is superb. The building is nice and well-planned with good architecture. The campus is also nice and eco-friendly. Classrooms are very spacious, and there is a very big auditorium. The college has two libraries: one is the main library, and the other is the digital library. The Wi-Fi connection is good, and anyone can use it.

reviews.review_heading: Very happy and satisfied with faculties and really good infrastructure. I loved it.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure is the best; the faculties are direct to us; they help us in every manner; they explain in details; and most important, the PowerPoint they make and study is so clear and makes us concentrated; everyone is given the opportunity to keep their thoughts based on the topics.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSS Medical College, JSS Academy of Higher Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are various classrooms and different buildings for separate courses like life sciences , MBBS, BS, etc. There are 2 libraries, one of which is a digital library, both with high-quality wifi . Hostel mess is good, though only vegetarian food is served.

reviews.review_heading: Actually, the infrastructure has to be improved.
reviews.review_text: No big infrastructure. I stay in PG that’s outside of the campus. Infrastructure has to be improved. We don’t get classrooms as such for us only. We’ll have to shift from one class to another with other years. Hope this will be completely confidential.

reviews.review_heading: Good curriculum and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is free all over the college. Classrooms are super clean with fans and some have AC. The library is excellent with ample space. The hostel is good with around 1 lakh per year, providing vegetarian food. The canteen is spacious with good hygiene. Medical facilities include a health card for each student, with free consultation and medicine from JSS hospital. Sports are conducted yearly, and an outdoor gym is also available.

reviews.review_heading: Found everything good at this college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of JSS Medical College are very well maintained and developed. The college management provides high-quality educational facilities to its students. The campus has Wi-Fi, medical labs, a library, a canteen, and sports facilities. Hostel facilities are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: JSS review with an amazing campus.
reviews.review_text:
We have Wi-Fi facilities for the whole campus, including the hostel and college. The library has a vast variety of books and is equipped with computers and Wi-Fi. For lectures, we have a smart board. 
The food quality in our hostel is better than most of the colleges. Sports facilities are available .

reviews.review_heading: My ongoing wonderful experience at JSS.
reviews.review_text: This college has a wonderful ambiance and beautiful infrastructure. Classrooms are very huge and a strength of more than 250 can fit into a single room. Wi-Fi facilities are provided for hostel members. The mess food is very good and we can find many varieties.

reviews.review_heading: My ongoing experience at JSS medical college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of this college are very good. They provide very tasty food inside the mess. The hostels are very good and clean and each is given only to two students. This college gives equal importance to sports and games as well.

reviews.review_heading: Beautiful infrastructure and nice placements.
reviews.review_text: This college has a mesmerizing infrastructure. The surroundings of the campus are very clean. There is a huge classroom, and all 250 students are made to sit in a single classroom. The mess food is acceptable, and we can find lots of varieties there.

reviews.review_heading: My ongoing experience at JSS.
reviews.review_text: The college's atmosphere and infrastructure are both appealing to me. Additionally, BDS College is conveniently situated on the same campus. This institution also places great emphasis on sports and games. The mess serves decent-quality food that is also quite tasty.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Psychiatry - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: The college provided good placement opportunities. After completing MD, you could work in a medical college, a private hospital, or as a teaching faculty to gain more experience, or even start your own clinic. The college supported us if we wanted to have our own startup.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel was in the college premises, but that building has now been transformed into the administrative block. At present, there are no hostel facilities. But, there was a college canteen inside the college premises.

individual_reviews.course: DM in Gastroenterology - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: The college is good overall.

content.Placements: The percentage of students that get placed every year in our college is 85% and almost all the students also get internship opportunities from the college itself. The top recruiting companies are Marks, Fortis and Apollo. The average salary goes up to 9 Lacs every year.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure that have been provided to us by our college are such that we have all the basic amenities in our college provided by our college. Other than that, we also have labs, library and other required necessities for a smooth college life and learning.

individual_reviews.course: MD in Psychiatry - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely worth it for any and every specialization or course.

content.Placements: Almost all the students in the batch got placed. The top recruiters were Max Healthcare, Fortis Healthcare, Apollo Hospital, and others. The highest package offered was Rs. 15 lacs per annum (and the average was Rs. 7 lacs per annum). The top roles offered were psychiatrist, addition psychiatrist, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Yes, high-speed internet is available through the Wi-Fi. The library has a vast collection of books for the students of all departments to read. The hostels have a premium feel, and all the important amenities are available. The food provided in the mess is of excellent quality as well.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Brilliant faculty members.

content.Placements: We don't get placements, but get to do a 1 year internship provided by the college itself for which we get a stipend of 15k per month. The college has a hospital affiliated to it called the Dayanand Hospital. We have to complete the internship period in that hospital which provides us all the facilities and services to support us.
content.Infrastructure: The college organises various seminars and workshops to enhance the learning skills of students. Other than that, there are cultural as well as sports related programs in the college. Ectopia is the cultural fest and Nozit is the sports fest which is conducted every year. College does have hostel facility for the students. Hostel rooms are neat and clean. There are only 3 students in each room. All rooms and washrooms are kept clean. Food quality of the mess is very good and all hygienic measures are taken care of. There is special dining hall too.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I had a good experience with our college and faculty members.

content.Placements: In our batch, there are 100 students. If you join Dayanand Medical College, you have to pay the maximum fee of 40 lacs for the entire MBBS course. However, with this huge amount of fee, you get top studies, good infrastructure and experienced teachers. I miss all the faculty members of our college.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are easily available both in the college and hospital campus. This college mainly considers the health of every student. The entire campus is air-conditioned. The food served in the hostel is also very good. So, I suggest you to work hard and pass in the exams.

paragraphs: Dayanand Medical College admission process 2024is olyentrance-based. Dayanand Medical College and Hospital is a leading college in the state ofLudhiana,Punjabengrossed in offering a range ofmedical courses.DMCHoffers UG, PG, and Super Specialty (SS) in the field of medicine. For admission to MBBS, MD, and MS courses, candidates must appear forNEETorPunjab NEETentrance exam.

For MBBS course, the DMCH admissions 2024 are done by theBaba Farid University of Health Sciences,Faridkotthroughcentralised counsellingonmerit-based NEETscores. For UG admission, candidates must have passed Class 12 with relevant subjects along with other entranc exam. The table below provides the admission requirements forDMCH popular courses:
Dayanand Medical College fees include various components, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, medical insurance, mess charges, etc.

Candidates must apply on the official website of NEET or Punjab NEET entrance exam, and appear for the exam.

review_summary.college_name: Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Fire Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: National Fire Service College

content.Placements: Enrolled in 32 and Batch of B. Tech Fire Engineering at National Fire Service College, Nagpur. Batch strength of 71. NFSC offers average package of 14 LPA. The highest 24 LPA and the lowest 7 LPA. Companies in past are BPCL, IOCL, HPCL, GAIL, ONGC, SAIL. Recruited as a fire officer.
content.Infrastructure: Well-maintained AC classrooms. Hostel is cleaned on a regular basis. Food in mess is up to the mark. Hostel comprises 8 floors where each room has 2 persons staying together. Proper furniture across each room. Two proper almirahs in each room. Four-time food offered in mess every day.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: In my opinion, it’s a good college in this Nagpur area.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are good but not excellent. More than 70 percent of students are placed during placement campus drives. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest average is 4 LPA. Some top recruiters are Infosys, Cognizant, Microsoft, Capgemini, etc. Internships are provided for all the students, not only from the college but also from outside.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in our college is good; all the facilities are available on campus regarding your branch. Labs are available anytime with experienced lab assistants. Wi-Fi connectivity is also good. Libraries are well-stocked and always available. Hostel facilities are excellent, with a neat and clean campus. The canteen provides nice food of good quality, and the rates are also cheap.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely perfect for new students who want to take IT in Nagpur.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are very good, and the ratio is also high for students to get placed in this course. Mostly, students get placed in this course, around 70–80 percent get placed. The highest package offered in our course is 24 LPA, and the lowest package is 9 LPA. The top recruiting companies which came to our college are Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and many others. Internships are provided in our college, but in the last year of the course.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in our college is top-notch, and in our department, all the facilities are provided by the college, there are no compromises anywhere. Wi-Fi connectivity is also good. Classrooms are always clean, the library is well-stocked and always available. The canteen is also available with a variety of food, though the quality of food is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is good, the teaching is good, but the college is out of the city, it is near Fetri.

content.Placements: On average, 30-40% student get placed. This year's average package is 4.5 LPA, and the highest is 6 LPA. The companies that give chances are Tata Motors, Horoko, Zapyee, and Shopkart. Mainly, the IT role they offer. Almost 60% student get an internship, and many want to go for higher education.
content.Infrastructure: The college contains 3 buildings, and it has 5 branches, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Civil Engineering, IT Engineering, and Electrical Engineering. All labs contain a good PC, each with atleast i5 and a good graphics card. The library is there with a good amount of books to read. All campus contains Wi-Fi, and each department contains each personal Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering(Data Science) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: In my opinion, it's good to gain knowledge here.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are good but not excellent. As compared to other colleges in Nagpur, this college is average because there are many engineering colleges in Nagpur that provide better placement than ours. The highest package goes to 7 LPA and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Internships are not provided in our college, you have to do them on your own.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure in our campus is neither good nor bad, just average. Our department has average infrastructure, and other facilities are also available, but they are not good. Wi-Fi facilities are available in various areas and departments, but not in the whole area. The library is well stocked, and always books are available in it, but our library days are once a week, which creates some difficulties. Canteen is present, but varieties are not available, only a few items are available in the canteen.

admission_process.title: Gujarat Technological University Admission Process 2024

paragraphs: Gujarat Technological University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, PG diploma, integrated, and doctoral courses in various fields. Admission to these courses is based on either the scores of entrance exams specified by the University or the merit list prepared by the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC). There is the provision of a 10% relaxation in eligibility criteria for the reserved category in GTU.
Gujarat Technological University has five dominant schools. The university offers respective courses under these schools. Thefive schools of Gujarat Technological Universityare:

Gujarat Technological University admission to its courses is based on merit. Some of its courses are merit-based and prepared by ACPC, while some require the scores of national-level entrance tests. The main selection body for Gujarat Technological University admission is the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC). The table below represents the top Gujarat Technological University courses are given in the table below:
Selection Criteria
GUJCET,JEE Main

Gujarat Technological University feesmay include various components such as Tuition Fees, Admission Fees, etc. Candidates have to pay a certain amount of fees at the time of admission. The university accepts various payment methods, including, credit card, debit card, net banking, and UPI.Gujarat Technological University seat intakevaries as per the course and specialisation selected by the students. To secure a seat at the university students must participate in the counselling. GTUseatsvary for both on-campus and affiliated colleges. Students can check out the following table to learn about the total seat intake for some of the popular Gujarat Technological University Dharwad courses: The table below mentions theGujarat Technological University feesand average package for various UG & PG courses:
Note:This information is taken from official sources/ sanctioning bodies and is subjective.

The admission procedure for Gujarat Technological University involves multiple steps, such as appearing for the accepted entrance exam, application, selection, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission must fulfil all of the required admission criteria before applying. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed GTUadmissions process:
Step 1: Gujarat Technological University Application Process 2025

Gujarat Technological University's admission processstarts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at GTU. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses at Gujarat Technological University is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such asJUCET, and JEEMain for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Gujarat Technological University entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Gujarat Technological University (GTU) admissions are primarily through ACPC, following entrance tests such as GUJCET or JEE for undergraduate studies and GATE or CMAT for postgraduation. Direct admissions are not generally permitted, with the exception of the management quota in affiliated institutions. Diploma students can apply for lateral entry to the second year of particular courses. If you’re considering direct admission, it’s best to check the policies for your desired programme and college. For courses like BCA, BBA and BVoc admission is based on merit.

faqs.question: Is Gujarat Technological University entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: The difficulty of the entrance exams for Gujarat Technological University (GTU), like GUJCET and JEE Main, really depends on your preparation and the course you're aiming for. GUJCET is generally considered to be of moderate difficulty, covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

faqs.question: Can I join GTU Ahmedabad MBA course without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: No, candidates are not allowed to join the GTU Ahmedabad MBA course without an entrance exam. Securing good scores in CMAT is compulsory to get admission into the Master of Business Administration programme at GTU Ahmedabad. GTU Ahmedabad MBA admissions are based on candidates' achieved scores in CMAT,  followed by Presentation cum Interview. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Reality of so called reputed university.

content.Placements: Placements are pretty mediocre at their best, only 30 percent of students get placed mainly in software based companies and we do not have proof that we ever have a product based company for placements. The roles offered are pretty basic and only very few get the opportunity for internship.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is below average. You get pretty slow Wi-Fi in campuses, classrooms are cleaned once a week, medical facilities are not free and they are very expensive if it is an emergency too and the hostel is fine there is nothing too fancy or bad, but the food is bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure could be improved, and good placements last year.

content.Placements: I just joined my batch a few months ago. I don’t know the placement percentage, but there are 63 students enrolled in my course. I also don’t know the package system yet. The recruiting companies for my course are SYASANS and ZOHO, and the top roles are Senior Microbiologist and Lab Technician.
content.Infrastructure: The whole college is divided into particular blocks for certain courses. Some newly built blocks are very comfortable, but the block I am in, the first building made, is honestly not the ideal block to have classrooms in. I come from Lucknow, and it is sort of difficult for me at the start, but now I have adjusted to hostel life. It has been a hard journey, but overall, the hostel is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty and better studies.

content.Placements: Legal side roles are offered in limited companies only. The highest package for my course is more than 1 lakh per semester. 100% of students are placed in my course. We have three sections in each batch. Top recruiters are Zoho Corporation, HDFC Bank, and other companies.
content.Infrastructure: We have labs, a moot court hall, classroom projectors, and a library for our course. The quality of food is okay but not very hygienic. They provide both veg and non-veg from the same canteen, and a medical room is available. Sports and games are conducted every semester in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. Computer Science in Cyber Security - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely very good college you can go for it if you get a scholarship .

content.Placements: Totally 92 percentage of students are placed in my college but we can't predict what kind of job they will get some may I get placed in a very good company or some way even get placed in normal company and they are very few top companies will come for the campus interview like accenture company etc. But only three company will come which are like top they will provide you intention in the summer holidays but you have to pay separately for the term internship top role in my core is like data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: The food will be good but the feels will be or nearly one Lacs per annum labs and classroom will be very good the bench will also be very clean and they will be SMART board projector etc. In every classes there is no Wi-Fi connection the library will be common for all the department also you will be very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech Electronics and computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A short review of VELS School of Engineering.

content.Placements: Don't need to worry about placements. VELS is providing good placements, 90% of the students particularly. They have been doing good in this part for the recent few years. VELS is a trusted university. They are offering placements from good companies, salary is not so high but I can say that VELS is one of the top 10 colleges in Chennai that is offering good placements with a decent salary package.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good. Hostel is not a good option not satisfied with my college hostel but it's not that bad also. Well, there are also not much canteens present in my college. Mess food is good. So, if you ask me an overall review of my college's infrastructure and facilities it is average but manageable.

VISTAS offers residential accommodation for more than 1,000 students within the campus premises. library.description:
VELS Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced Studies has a fully automated central library with a seating capacity of 500 persons and follows Open Access System. The library has a collection of 114305 books, 137717 e-books, and 10032 back volumes. It has the subscription of more than 359 Periodicals (National & International), more than 12381 e-journals, 4106 dissertations, 4849 audio-visual resources.
It also facilitates access to e-journals from IEEE/IEL, ASME, ASCE, EBSCO, ProQuest, BENTHAM Science Pharmacy, Micromedex’s Drugdex System, Inventi Online, Nature Online, Law finder, NPTEL etc.
The library is also an associate member of Madras Library Network (MALIBNET) and Institutional member British Council Library.

The University houses Ten hostels (AC and NON AC Hostels) 5 Boys Hostel, 3 Girls Hostel a NRI Hostel and an International Students’ Hostel — providing a safe, inclusive, and multicultural living environment.
Rooms are available on a shared basis (2 to 4occupants) with all essential amenities, including air-conditioned options. The hostels have spacious dining halls serving multi-cuisine meals (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian) prepared in hygienic conditions.

reviews.review_heading: Reality of so called reputed university.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is below average. You get pretty slow Wi-Fi in campuses, classrooms are cleaned once a week, medical facilities are not free and they are very expensive if it is an emergency too and the hostel is fine there is nothing too fancy or bad, but the food is bad.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by School of Life Sciences, VELS Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced StudiesReviewed on 7 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure could be improved, and good placements last year.
reviews.review_text: The whole college is divided into particular blocks for certain courses. Some newly built blocks are very comfortable, but the block I am in, the first building made, is honestly not the ideal block to have classrooms in. I come from Lucknow, and it is sort of difficult for me at the start, but now I have adjusted to hostel life. It has been a hard journey, but overall, the hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with memory space.
reviews.review_text: We have good labs with a Wi-Fi connection. All computers are high in standards. We have a huge library which is helpful for students to learn. We can yearly sports activities to support physical skills.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by School of Computing Science, VELS Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced StudiesReviewed on 19 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Computer labs have AC. It is a good and cool lab system. Wi-Fi is awesome and it has good speed but only in lab, you can access the phones only by without knowing and sneaky. The library is fine. The hostel is average. Canteen provides snack items, which are good and meals are average.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by VELS School of Management Studies and CommerceReviewed on 9 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: My college is very bad at parking. They should improve it.
reviews.review_text: Our department staff is good, but the only problem is the building. It is an old building and has many problems due to a lack of maintenance. At least they can improve the seating benches and replace all the electrical equipment with new ones. That may help.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's very good for students' sake.
reviews.review_text: The atmosphere around the campus, especially for the hostel students studying at our university, is good. The infrastructure is good, and Wi-Fi facility is available for students. They can visit the library after class hours at any time, as it remains open until 8:00 PM. The university provides all necessary facilities and shows extra involvement in sports activities for the benefit of students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, really good for learn more things and parts about life.
reviews.review_text: My department has free Wi-Fi, labs, and smart classroom facilities. The hostel food is not bad, but it is good to eat. Some foods, like poori, are not as good, but no one can complain about it because the food is not bad in flavor and taste. It is lower in cost compared to homemade food, but it's okay. The entire campus is very clean.
