individual_reviews.course: B.A. B.Ed. - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with my university. Students will learn many things at this university.

content.Placements: Placement of students in my course is 100 percent. There is no particular package for my course at university. I don't know about other courses in my university, but there is a placement occurring in PhDs. There are many PhD scholars who are selected for foreign universities. But in my course, there is no placement. Maybe 20-30 percent of students, professor.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are the best in my university. Classes, benches, cleanliness, everything is very good, and we feel positive in class.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Really one of the best central universities.

content.Placements: The placement record is not too good and very limited. Most core-science placements (like in R&D or chemical industries) are not widely available through campus. Some students may get opportunities through faculty referrals or collaborative projects.
content.Infrastructure: Food quality is average, but other hostel facilities are really awesome. Hostel staff and warden are very good and helpful. All rooms are well furnished, and in each room, 2 beds, 2 tables, and 2 chairs are available, and the quality is also good. Overall, the infrastructure is really good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Well, it's affordable and offers a healthy atmosphere for you to grow.

content.Placements: They manage to bag companies and firms to place their students in them. There is an internship and placement cell made for the accommodation of smooth functioning. Insofar as there has been a better placement opportunity in last 2-3 years. University is growing at a high pace.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and buildings are newly constructed and reliable. It's a growing university, so it tries to provide best for other students and coworkers. Overall, it's a great pico at an affordable price because of its low fee structure as compared to other state universities.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. B.Ed. - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really a very nice experience in this university.

content.Placements: I'm a student of B.A. B.Ed where our university provides a minimum placement of 30% at an average package of 3-4 LPA in top institutions like D.A.V. In CUSB, 100% of students got internships related to respective government schools. The top role offered in my course is to prepare teachers and professors for educated students.
content.Infrastructure: Well-comfortable classrooms with worth tables, Wi-Fis, huge lab rooms, and a separate library. In our hostel, suitable rooms for students are provided along with proper security CCTV cameras. Proper mess facilities with good food and hygiene, and all medical, sports, and game facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Super college where you get everything at a minimal fee.

content.Placements: I am from the 2021-26 batch of CUSB. Most of the students opt for Judiciary after college. Out of 120 students around 20 students clear Judiciary every year. Last year Bajaj Alliance selected 3 hires with a salary of 5.5 LPA. Internships are mandatory for every student and some also get an opportunity to do internships in reputed firms.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good. You will get every kind of sports ground on the campus. Campus is also equipped with all kinds of laboratories, big library, moot court hall, and many more. All the classes have smart boards. We have Wi-Fi everywhere on the campus. Hostel is just okay.

reviews.review_heading: Central University of South Bihar - my dream college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure related to courses and the hostel is fabulous and outstanding. The university offers only three undergraduate courses: B.A. LL.B. Honors, B.A. B.Ed., and Agriculture Honors. The faculty for each course is excellent and dedicated to the development of students. The hostel infrastructure is amazing, providing every facility from top to bottom.

reviews.review_heading: CUSB present a mixed bag of learning.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good. There is a need to look after mess food. But overall, it is good. The infrastructure for sports is well developed, as there is a stadium, i.e., Milkha Singh Stadium for the supporters. There is a Madhuvan canteen for the student's food.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: This college has very good infrastructure for our course. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, etc., facilities are given to the students of this college. The quality of these facilities is good. The mess and canteen food are good to eat. Medical and sports facilities are also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not bad; it is very friendly and provides a good and spacious environment in both the hostel and course area. We do have a library and a small lab. We have internet access, but it is limited to the course area, and the food in the mess is average but provides both veg and non-veg meals.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience and learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and student-friendly; we can find materials like offline and online resources essential for project work and research papers. There are also labs and good internet connectivity. The classrooms are nicely designed with good space. The hostel has room for laundry; you need to pay a bit extra, but the mess fee is included.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty members and affordability are good options.
reviews.review_text: The hostel living space is good for the amount that they charge, and they provide the best amenities with that. There is a mess where both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food options are available, along with the fact that in the department area we have our classroom, library, lab, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the course area has a dedicated classroom and a library where materials are available. There is an internet connection, but it is limited to the labs area. In the hostel area, we have food available, and for accommodation, you will be given a room, but for other things, you will have to manage.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure both in the department area as well as the hostel area is quite basic. There is not much new software or available modern amenities. Like new journals or e-resources are very limited; the food is also of average quality, and hostel rooms are available on a sharing basis.

admission_process.title: MIT-WPU, Pune Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: MIT WPU admissionto all the programmes is conducted online. The application process for all UG, PG and PhD courses. Check below the steps forMIT-WPU admission processfor all courses:
Step 1: MIT-WPU Application Process 2026
Aspirants need to fill an online application form on the official website of MIT-WPU with all the information. Candidates need to pay INR 2,000 as application fees for a course.
Step 2: Entrance Exam, Result & Counselling

Candidates must appearMIT entrance exam, followed by other selection rounds after filling out the MIT-WPU registration form. Based on the entrance exam scores results will be declared on the official website of MIT-WPU and a merit list will be prepared through a counselling process. Candidates with a score in any of the accepted national-level entrance exams can also get admission.
Step 3: Fee Payment
The university sends a provisional offer letter to selected candidates. Applicants who receive the offer letter must make the first fee instalment.
Step 4: Declaration of Final Offer Letter

The university releases the final offer letter after the completion of document verification. The University sends the offer letter to the student's registered email address. Candidates have to submit the original documents for verification. Aspirants need to payMIT WPU feesto confirm their seat.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to B.Tech at MIT-WPU Pune?
faqs.answer: For admission to the BTech course, MIT-WPU, Pune accepts scores of various state/ national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main/ MHT CET/ PERA CET/ MHT CET B/ NEET UG. Hence, candidates willing to get admission to the course must appear and qualify in any one of the accepted entrance exams. For some specialisations, students may have to write a Statement of Purpose (SOP).

faqs.question: How can we get direct admission at MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU Pune does not offer direct admission to its UG and PG courses. MIT-WPU course admissions for all courses are either done via MIT-WPU CET, which is conducted by the university itself. The university also accepts various state and national-level entrance exams such as PERA CET, JEE Main, CAT, MAT, NEET UG, etc. Those who want to get admission to any of the UG and PG courses at MIT-WPU, must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place and then appear for the respective entrance exams. For some PG courses such as MBA and MCA, the university also accepts valid scores in personal interview rounds as part of their selection process. The final seat allotment is done based on the counselling rounds.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at MIT-WPU, Pune?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU, Pune provides various programmes and specialisations to students. These courses are available in different streams. For obtaining MIT-WPU, Pune admission, candidates are selected on the basis of entrance tests. For further details, candidates may visit the official website and learn more regarding the eligibility details for their preferred course choice. Accepted exams include PERA CET, MHT CET, JEE Main, NEET, LSAT, CLAT, etc.

faqs.question: Do I need to give an entrance exam for admission to MBA at MIT School of Management?
faqs.answer: MIT WPU Pune accepts multiple entrance exams for admission to the MBA course. Candidates can apply for any one of the entrance exams for admission. The final selection is based on the performance of candidates in Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds, followed by other selection rounds. Few of the entrance exams are as follows:CAT Common Admission TestMAT Management Aptitude TestXAT  Xavier Aptitude TestMaharashtra Common Entrance Exam MAH CET

placement_data.title: MIT-WPU, Pune Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: MIT-WPU, Pune has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. More than 730 recruiters visited the campus for 2025 placements and selected 2455 students of the batch 2025. The overall highest package offered to the batch 2025 stood at INR 51.36 LPA , whereas the average salary offered was INR 6.23 LPA. The median salary offered to the batch 2025 was INR 5.50 LPA . The top recruiters of MIT-WPU, Pune in 2025 include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman Sachs, etc. Apart from securing the annual package, the students also received internship opportunities from the recuiters in 2025. The highest stipend offered was INR 80,000.

Earlier, the highest package offered during MIT-WPU, Pune placement 2024 stood at INR 51.36 LPA. A total 2,544 students registered, of which 1,903 were placed in leading companies. More than 600 companies visited the campus.
The students of the BDes batch 2023 secured the highest package of INR 20 LPA.

hostel.description:
MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Equipped with amenities such as dance studios, gyms, basketball courts, and inviting common areas, the hostels offer a vibrant and engaging living environment. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. 

The safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric-enabled entrances ensuring a secure living space. MIT-WPU's commitment to providing well-equipped and secure hostels reflects its dedication to creating a conducive and enriching residential experience for its students.

reviews.review_heading: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave...

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library.  Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum was different from the rest of the colleges. There was a brew of finance, operations, marketing, and HR for the elective options. They imparted both theoretical and practical knowledge. It was a very flexible system that favors students for their betterment. The hostel was completely air conditioned and was equipped with free Wi-Fi. There was ample space provided for the balcony and terrace. The rooms were dual sharing with separate washroom facilities for each room. The me...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and friendly faculty with a fresh environment and campus.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has good facilities of Wi-Fi, smart Google classrooms, and well-stocked libraries. Hostel facilities are designed with hygienic food. Even with the good medical facilities and well-trained doctors. The college also supports sports and various national and international competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have a specially designed Vyasa building for CSE branch students. It's definitely amazing, the labs are brand new, and each system actually works. The only thing is that the network connectivity is terrible. The mess is good, but the En Encave Cafe is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with top-notch infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side.
reviews.review_text: Cannot comment on hostel as I am a day scholar. Infrastructure available is of top-notch quality. Many canteens are available on the campus. Library has some limited books and is not up to date.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU  This is the reality.
reviews.review_text: There are well-developed and invested labs for different subjects. Campus has Wi-Fi. Library is also very useful and very accessible. Campus has a medical room for emergencies, and the hostels are decent. Hostels are okay, but they are extremely far away from the college. Although the college offers transport, it gets tiring to travel that much every single day.

placement_data.title: Kumaun University Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: According to Kumaun University overall NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during Kumaun University UG 3-year and PG 2-year placements 2023 stood at INR 1.2 LPA and INR 2 LPA , respectively. Further, as per the Management and Pharmacy NIRF reports 2024, the median package offered during Kumaun University MBA, BPharm and MPharm placements 2023 stood at INR 5 LPA , INR 2.5 LPA and INR 4 LPA, respectively.

Earlier, according to Kumaun University NIRF report 2023, the median package offered during Kumaun University UG 3-year and PG 2-year placements 2022 stood at INR 0.75 LPA and INR 1.5 LPA . Apart from this, the median package offered during Kumaun University MBA placements 2022 stood at INR 5 LPA . Moreover, a total of 33 students were placed out of 51 students during Kumaun University MBA placements 2022.

reviews_list.review_title: Life of a MBBS student at IMS BHU.

review_content.Placements: There is no such thing as campus placements in MBBS but during internships at MBBS, you will get Rs 30,000 per month in BHU. After which you have to pass the post graduate exam, and you can become a junior president doctor in the department of your choice where you will get a salary of 1 lakh per month. After completion of your post-graduation you can work in private or in government as an assistant professor where the salary ranges from 1 lakh to 3 lakhs per month.
review_content.Infrastructure: The whole campus has Wi-Fi and the hostels are renovated with all necessary facilities like geyser, CCTV, and 24X7 guard. reviews.review_heading: Occupational therapy is the best course from the best college Seth GS Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The department has its separate library. Classrooms are well-ventilated and labs are fully equipped. Mess food is great and we will get the whole lunch for Rs. 30.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied wholeheartedly and a good place to be. No toxic culture.
reviews.review_text: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are available. The quality is fine, and mess and canteen are bearable. Medical facilities are good and sports are excellent. Our department is well-equipped with modern infrastructure that supports a better learning experience. Laboratories are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: This year I joined this college. Faculty members are nice.
reviews.review_text: Main library is well-maintained. We have two libraries, one is department and other one is in the main building of college. Wi-Fi facilities are available. Practical labs are also well maintained. Hostel for 1st year is not available for any course because of shortage of hostel. Mess and canteen food is also average.

reviews.review_heading: Ragging-free campus. Seniors guide like elder siblings (so friendly).
reviews.review_text: Lectures are presented on screens using PPTs. There are sliding blackboards. Demo rooms each have projectors and blackboards. There are biochemistry labs, a dissection hall, and 3-4 auditoriums. Libraries are huge, with central AC, and are well-maintained, clean, and stocked with all the books. Messes are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: The Occupational Therapy in Occupational Therapy.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is old from the British rule, but it’s better than today’s buildings. A 24*7 library is provided. You will get a hostel in the 2nd year, and you have to share it with 2-3 students. You will get a bed and table there. Classrooms are well-ventilated, clean, and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The descriptions of life at GSMC.
reviews.review_text: The physiotherapy department is a little outdated, as physiotherapy requires frequent updates in equipment and syllabus. The department could benefit from being situated in a place with more natural light. Hostel accommodation is another issue since not everyone gets a nearby hostel, which is more than 40 minutes away.

reviews.review_heading: My MBBS is from GS Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, libraries, canteens, etc., were given to the students. Sports facilities were available at the college for the students. Hostel facilities were available for the students. Facilities in the hostels were of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good infrastructure and amenities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities such as free Wi-Fi, libraries, air-conditioners, canteens, food services, a gym, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has great sports facilities but faculty members are not good.
reviews.review_text: In our college, both indoor and outdoor games are available for those students who are interested. Air-conditioners are available in the library. Medical facility is also available. Journals and reference books are provided. It also has ample space for reading. Hostel facilities are better, and the hostel fee structure is around Rs 6,000 - Rs 8,000 per year. Around 4 students can share each room. It also provides a bed and table, but shelves are not provided for the first two years.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best medical college in Maharashtra.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hospital was good. But the food served was not good at all. There were more cadavers to study anatomy. The department of anatomy was the best among all the other departments. The library was awesome. There were so many books and also free Wi-Fi. All the classrooms of SETH GS Mumbai are smart classrooms. The badminton court was also very well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Best medical college in Mumbai and Maharashtra.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very nice I would like to give 5 stars but when it comes to hostels especially the boy's hostel I'll give only 2 stars. Capacity is also less for boys. From this year students get hostel from their second year and they have to rent a room in their first year. Hospital infrastructure is average and maintained at an optimum level. Girls hostels are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with college, really good infrastructure, and very good staff.
reviews.review_text: There are huge classrooms and clean corridors. The staff is really very cooperative and good. They help out in searching for the different departments. The college is huge with good infrastructure and numerous departments along with the latest technology in the medical field.

reviews.review_heading: Good quality of education .
reviews.review_text: Hostel is decent. It does not contains the facility of Wi-Fi. Hostel building is decent. Library is furnished with the availability of air conditioning. Our college also has a turf where we play football. It also has a basketball court. It has a mess with decent pricing.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is well-developed.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available here. The library is open 24 hours for students to study. There is a badminton court, football court, basketball and tennis court with table tennis and other games. The college also has its own CCD and canteen. The quality of food is also good and affordable.

reviews.review_heading: The college has top faculty members, the best academics, and super competitive environment.
reviews.review_text: The college building is self-sufficient and well equipped. GSMC has a fully air-conditioned central library, with ample amount of space, free Wi-Fi, intranet, and KEM'S library is also a hub for the western region of the country. The campus has 3 canteens and free Wi-Fi.

college_info.intro:
Armed Forces Medical College offers a range of courses in fields like Medicine, Health Sciences, Nursing, etc. The college offers courses at the UG, PG, and Doctorate levels. MBBS & BSc Nursing are some of the most popular courses offered by the institution. The duration of the MBBS course is 4 ½ years followed by compulsory rotating internship training of one year. All medical cadets after completing final MBBS examination will undergo internship training in selected service hospitals recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Students who want to take admission for MBBS course at AFMC Pune will have to mandatorily qualify the NEET UG Exam conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA). On successful completion of MBBS Course from AFMC, the medical cadets join the Armed Forces Medical Services as Commissioned Officers in one of the three services - Army, Navy and Air Force. On the basis of merit-cum-choice 50% of the medical cadets are offered Permanent Commission (PC) and the rest Short Service Commission (SSC).
The College of Nursing under AMFC Pune offers BSc Nursing at UG level. It is offered for the duration of 4 years. The seat intake for this course is 40 seats. The number of seats vary every year based on cut off. After completing the course students can work in Hospitals, Clinics, Military, or go for higher studies like MSc Nursing which is also offered by the college. individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College that will fulfil your dream.

content.Placements: Here, we will first pursue our MBBS, then we are appointed as medical officers in the field for sure, and then we serve the nation in our post. This is a central government-funded job, and we receive a package similar to that of a doctor, along with some allowances according to the Armed Forces.
content.Infrastructure: The college is located in the heart of Pune and is surrounded by lush greenery. It spans an area of around 120 acres and is well-built. There are sports grounds for multiple sports, along with separate boys' and girls' hostels accommodating around 750 students.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college has excellent extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: In our college, we had an internship for one year and the stipend was Rs.65,000 per month, which is probably the highest in India. Once you complete your studies, you will have to serve as a medical officer for the next 4 years in any defense hospital in India.
content.Infrastructure: Almost all sports were played. We had a huge ground for such sports. Labs were the best in the country and were approved by the government of India. All tests required for any diagnosis were done in our labs.
content.Faculty: The MBBS course is a vast course consisting of 14 huge subjects that expanded over four and a half years. It trains you to be a good doctor and how to behave, interact with, and treat patients. The structure of the exams is simple and consists of six-month semesters. There are university exams at the end of each year.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The best medical college in India. It doesn't keep you bound to the curriculum.

content.Placements: The cadets are offered placements in the all three armed forces wing such as air force, navy and military force as a medical officer with a rank similar to that of NDA cadets. They have an option to choose between SSC (short service commission) and PC (permanent commission) and also subject to the seat availability, or you can pay out by paying 28 Lacs, which is the bond-money as of the year, 2016.

Hostel rooms are way better than the hostels in other institutes. Students get single occupancy rooms after the 1st year.

faqs.answer: The selection will be based on the merit of the candidate at an All India level. faqs.question: How to get admission in AFMC for MBBS?
faqs.answer: Armed Forces Medical College (AMFC) offers an MBBS lasting five and a half years, including a compulsory rotating internship of one year. AMFC MBBS admission is based on the applicants' NEET (UG) score. Based on the exam scores, applicants are called for a screening process, which comprises a Test of English Language and Reasoning (ToELR), Psychological Assessment Test (PAT), Interview and Medical Examination at AFMC, Pune. paragraphs: Q. What is the stipend given to the students during their training period?

A. A stipend of INR 250 per month is given during the four years of training. An initial outfit allowance of INR 800 is given on joining the course and an outfit renewal allowance of INR 300 per year during the 2nd, 3rd and 4th year of the course.
Q. In what areas do students of AFMC get jobs?

A. The medical cadets have the privilege to be either in the Indian Army, Navy or Air Force after completing their programme from AFMC. Students have an option of choosing between SSC (short service commission) and PC (permanent commission) and also subject to seat availability.
Q. In case any student does not wish to serve SSC or PC, what should they do?

A. In case any student wants to leave the tenure of serving SSC or PC in between, they can buy out that time by paying INR 28 Lacs to the authority. This amount to subject to change by the government.

reviews.review_text: We have 2 libraries, one with books and the other one is a digital library. Both of them are very well-equipped with a vast amount of books and medical magazines. Classrooms are very good. The labs in our college are very advanced. The hostel is nearby and has all the required amenities.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied with the quality of education.
reviews.review_text: There was no allotment of hostel for Bachelor of Science (Medical Laboratory Technology) in BMC&RI. One had to find a hostel/PG on their own. Also, there were no facilities like sports, gym, cafeteria, ground, or auditorium provided for this course. Infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There are no proper facilities for sports and for organizing cultural events and fests. However, we manage in the space provided by our college. Labs and classrooms are considered decent. There are 5 associated hospitals. Hostel are 3 for boys and 2 for girls.

reviews.review_heading: We have a good patient inflow and a very popular college and hospital.
reviews.review_text: The college offers Wi-Fi in the digital library. Cassrooms are spacious enough to accommodate 250 students. There are reading rooms available in both the college and the hostel. The library is located on the college campus, along with a digital library. There are three hostels for boys and one hostel for girls. The food quality is good, with mess charges of Rs. 4,000 per month. There are various sports and games available for students to participate in.

reviews.review_heading: Top State College, Better Exposure Than Some AIIMS.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 hostels for boys and 2 for girls with healthy food at a minimal cost. The hostels are very near to the college. The college has 8 floors with various labs and air-conditioned classrooms, well-equipped with projectors and speakers, a sports room, and various clubs like music, sports, social, etc.

reviews.review_heading: BMCRI college life for MBBS students .
reviews.review_text: We have very well-equipped labs for practicals with all the facilities. The physiology department has a hematology lab, human physiology lab, and clinical physiology lab. For anatomy, we have histology and dissection halls and also osteology. For biochemistry, we have a biochem lab. We also have sports like Cricket, Basketball courts, and Volleyball courts.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good, and infrastructure is good, but there is no ground.
reviews.review_text: In our college, the hostel facility is very good and there are many facilities like Wi-Fi, which help a lot in the hostel. There are many labs which help in understanding the subject, and one big library is there for studies and books to refer to. In our hostel, they give good and healthy food and maintain a good mess and canteen. There is also a little bit of sports available.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for pursuing MBBS.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good facilities such as labs, library, classrooms, and hostel. The hostel rooms are not too bad, but each room has three beds, which is a bit crowded. One of the problems with our hostel is bed bugs, which can be really disturbing. The food quality is quite good, and there is no canteen. The medical facilities and sports opportunities are all good.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best medical college.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good hostel facilities, separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostel provides basic facilities like water purifiers and water coolers, washing machines. The hostel food is very tasty. Our college provides good equipment, all labs, and well-arranged classrooms with projectors. The best infrastructure, and we have a well-stocked library.

reviews.review_heading: Govt Medical College explained.
reviews.review_text: The course and academic infrastructure are very good, but the hostel can be improved, especially the boys' hostel. We have very good hospitals associated with our college, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, and there is a large patient crowd, which helps in learning.

reviews.review_heading: MBBS from BMCRI University.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very good infrastructure for MBBS. College has all the facilities including Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, medical, sports, etc. Facilities for the students enhance better learning. Hostel of the college has facilities including furnished rooms, good quality mess food, etc. for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The top most government. Medical college of Karnataka.

For boys there are 3 hostels available, the one situated in the gandhinagar (Varuna hostel) is the best. The food is also better compared to the other hostels.

The meal is provided 3 times a day. Registration for a hostel is done on the administrative block. Nearby PG and rented rooms are easily available.
